fusions.name: Dig at the Mark
fusions.desc: Drives the blade in where you marked for 9 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Survey Pegs
fusions.desc: Throws 3 survey pegs at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighted Line
fusions.desc: Raises the reach of your attacks and spells by 30% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Staked Claim
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
